label: MatrixOne
description: MatrixOne is a hyper-converged cloud & edge native distributed database with a structure that separates storage, computation, and transactions to form a consolidated HSTAP data engine. This engine enables a single database system to accommodate diverse business loads such as OLTP, OLAP, and stream computing. It also supports deployment and utilization across public, private, and edge clouds, ensuring compatibility with diverse infrastructures.
